description: Return passages of the VISEON articles word for word, each with a link to the passage itself, the article it is part of and how much of the query it holds, so an answer can quote and cite them. query: the distinctive words asked about (a name, a term, a phrase the article uses). article: optional, an article's @id, page url or title, to look inside that article only. limit: 1 to 5 passages, default 3. The text is verbatim and unaltered: no model has read or paraphrased it. It matches the article's own words, so ask in the words the article would use; for what the graph says about an article (description, author, date, topics) use fuzzy_find_and_traverse and get_entity.
name: get_citable_passages
